capabilities: Assign a colour and shape to diagram nodes by role class
Provide built-in roles for clients, services, databases, queues, caches and storage
Add custom roles with their own colour, shape and dashed border
Adjust look, tint strength, border strength, corner radius and border width in settings
Keep left-to-right diagrams in their written direction instead of redrawing them top-down
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15 or later, which draws diagrams with Pele; settings are saved per vault and the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Diagram nodes have to be styled by hand in every note, so colours and shapes drift between diagrams and ignore the theme's palette.

relations.evidence: With the Style Settings plugin, Style Settings → Consistent System Design offers the look, the four sliders and a colour per built-in role
Works alongside other plugins that wrap Pele, such as Mermaid Flow Enhancer.

summary: Styles Mermaid flowchart nodes by role class so system design diagrams get theme-aware colours and shapes.
